title: LazyBeeFix
description: This mod fixed mc-168329 (bees not entering beehive sometimes in the nether/end).
body:
This mod fixed [mc-168329](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-168329).

This bug caused bees to not enter beehive sometimes in the nether/end.

This mod works by fixing isRaining(), so some similar bugs (though I don't know any) may also be fixed.
